prompts.name: intro
prompts.prompt: Use the input image as APPROVED ART STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: warm cream panel faces, chestnut wood, restrained fine amber/gold edges, thick dark brown cartoon outlines, glossy broad lime leaves and chunky orange mushrooms. Create ONE production-ready blank game UI asset, not a mockup, with no text, no icons, no currency, no pixel characters, no watermark. Match its decorative illustration exactly, clean 2D frontal view, no perspective. Asset: the standalone LEFT INTRODUCTION FRAME. Tall portrait approximately 340x860 aspect ratio. A single rounded chestnut/gold thin rim around a warm cream parchment interior. Glossy lime leaf cluster hugs the TOP LEFT corner, small two orange mushrooms plus broad lime leaves hugs BOTTOM LEFT corner, all contained in the silhouette. Large clear cream interior center blank from near top to bottom for live title and mascot. No acorns. NO secondary outer backing sheet or ledge. Fine amber rim, not thick metallic gold. Genuine transparent background outside silhouette, no padding more than 2%. Only one frame.
